minor.issue: Full replace-style update does not merge the 'integrations' sub-doc, so a settings write that only changes platform_name silently clobbers moyasar_enabled/domain_reseller_enabled — this makes TestPublic.test_domain_search_disabled and TestDisabledIntegrations.test_subscribe_payment_disabled flip depending on prior test run order. action_items: (Low) Fix admin settings PUT to preserve integrations flags OR update TestAdmin.test_update_settings_platform_name to snapshot+restore the full settings doc so subsequent disabled-integration tests stay green regardless of order.
critical_code_review_comments: public.create_store_order awaits send_contact_notification synchronously inside the request handler — a slow Resend response (up to 30s httpx timeout) blocks the customer's checkout submission. Wrap it in asyncio.create_task() / BackgroundTasks so the shopper gets the success response instantly and the email fires asynchronously.

public.create_store_order reuses send_contact_notification (a 'contact form' template) to notify the owner of an order. The template subject line is generic and the body is squeezed into the 'message' field. Consider a dedicated send_order_notification helper with proper subject, item table, currency + total prominently displayed so the owner email actually looks like an order alert.

StoreOrderBody has no validation on items[].price (float) or qty (int) being non-negative, and no server-side recomputation of total from items. A malicious buyer can POST total=0 or negative prices/quantities and the order is stored + emailed as-is. Add pydantic Field(ge=0)/(gt=0) on qty/price and recompute total = sum(item.price*item.qty) server-side.
GET /api/account/store-orders returns up to 500 orders with no pagination — will bloat StoreOrders page for busy stores. Add ?limit/skip and sort index on (owner_id, created_at desc).

Frontend cart is keyed by product index within the section data. If the owner reorders or removes a product between the buyer opening the site and completing checkout, cart quantities silently attach to the wrong product. Key by a stable product id (add an id field per product in seed & editor).
PUT /api/admin/settings replace-style update overwrites integrations sub-doc (see backend_issues.minor). Same class of bug will hit any future nested settings.
Prior iteration_2 comments still stand (raw reset token printed to backend logs, no metric for email failures, timing side-channel in forgot-password).
